items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: If he wasn't gonna leave with the band right then, he'd give me money to charter a bus. Or get a train and take the rest of the band on.

ctx.x: You brought up a point about, you've worked with a lot of big band leaders. Oh, yeah. Jay McShann. How do you, how do you rate Jay McShann? How was Jay McShann as a band leader as opposed to maybe other people?

To me, Jay McShann was terrific. And he's a terrific pianist. A lot of people here play in the blues, but they don't know that McShann is a concert pianist. Also a great organist, which he played around Kansas City years back. And he's not, people think he's from Kansas City, he's not. He's from Oklahoma. Think it's Oklahoma, Oklahoma. That's his home. He came into Kansas City. But he is a terrific musician. And maybe I liked him because he had so much interest in me, you know what I mean? He said I'm the only…
You mean the whole band was using dope?
